title: BAGMAN EvidenceClassificationRule
description: A deterministic, operator-governed document-classification rule (CD-6 Slice 5 WI-1 — see services.evidence.classification_rule's own module docstring). A SEPARATE governed authority from bagman.mailbox_domain_rule.v1 — never sharing its identity space or closed vocabularies. sender_scope_type/subject_predicate_type are this module's OWN closed sets. No ATTACHMENT_FILENAME sender scope exists in V1 — there is no governed attachment-extraction pipeline yet. Semantic fields (sender_scope_type, sender_scope_value, subject_predicate_type, subject_predicate_value, document_type) are set once at creation and never mutated; only status/retired_at ever change, via a single one-way ACTIVE -> RETIRED transition.

rule_id.description: Canonical BAGMAN identifier for this rule row.

sender_scope_type.description: Deliberately exactly two values in V1 — no ATTACHMENT_FILENAME scope (see module docstring).

sender_scope_value.description: The normalised sender domain or sender address this rule matches, depending on sender_scope_type — see the conditional format rules below.

subject_predicate_type.description: This module's own closed predicate-type vocabulary (identical values to bagman.mailbox_domain_rule.v1's own EXACT_DOMAIN_SUBJECT tier, but a separate closed set belonging to this authority). No CONTAINS, no regex, no glob.

subject_predicate_value.description: The predicate's own comparison value, always stored in canonical normalised form (Unicode NFKC, casefolded, stripped, internal whitespace collapsed — see services.mailbox.domain_rule.normalize_subject_for_policy, reused directly by this module).

document_type.description: The same closed V1 document-type vocabulary as bagman.evidence_classification.v1 — this rule's own governed answer for what document_type a matching message should be classified as.

status.description: A single one-way lifecycle: ACTIVE -> RETIRED only, never the reverse in V1. To express a changed decision: retire this rule, then create a brand new rule row (optionally pointing its own supersedes_rule_id back at this one).

source.description: Who/what proposed this rule. 'OPERATOR' — a human approved this rule directly. 'BAGMAN_PROPOSED' — forward-declared for a future automated-proposal producer; no producer exists in this delivery.

supersedes_rule_id.description: The prior rule row this rule replaces, if any. Null for a rule that is not itself a replacement of an earlier rule.

created_at.description: UTC timestamp this rule row was created.

approved_at.description: UTC timestamp this rule was approved by its source. Always populated at creation in this delivery (no unapproved-and-pending rule state is persisted in V1).

retired_at.description: UTC timestamp this rule was retired. Non-null if and only if status == 'RETIRED'.

allOf.description: status == RETIRED requires a real retired_at; status == ACTIVE requires retired_at to be null — mirrors bagman.mailbox_domain_rule.v1's own match_mode-conditional allOf/if/then pattern, applied here to the status/retired_at pair.
sender_scope_type == EXACT_SENDER_ADDRESS requires sender_scope_value to look like an email address — reuses bagman.mailbox_domain_rule.v1's own sender_address pattern verbatim.
sender_scope_type == EXACT_SENDER_DOMAIN requires sender_scope_value to look like a bare domain — reuses bagman.mailbox_domain_rule.v1's own sender_domain pattern verbatim.
